decision: Primary drafting route: Claude sub-agents (highest pilot score 50/50, fastest, parallelisable, consistently flags adjacent problems). Second route: Codex gpt-6.1-sol independently drafts every card; disagreements on proposed action are surfaced in the UI and prioritised in orchestrator review. agy (Gemini 3.8 Flash High) not used beyond the pilot: slowest (~3.7 min/card), one headless failure and one schema violation, and two cards asserted unverified facts or matches (41/50). The brief was revised after the pilot (v2: whole-article digest, explicit programme rule on secondary coverage for replication statements, adjacent-problem reporting, no memory assertions).
